subject: ACK: GP accessibility bugs (both already fixed)
body: Bug 1 (aria-labels): Fixed in commit 910706d (sw-18). chart13/15/19 have descriptive aria-labels. chart9 uses role=application. gp-aria-labels.test.js: 7/7 pass. Bug 2 (print CSS): exam.html already has @media print block (hides hint-btn, graph-controls, submit-area, nav-bar). gp-print-css.test.js: 3/3 pass. Both bugs closed.
